findings.evidence: EmissionScale.lean:152 `private theorem emissionLaw_Iic_eq_lintegral`; the only other public statements about `emissionLaw` are `emissionLaw_Iic` (l.161) and `isProbabilityMeasure_emissionLaw` (l.180).
findings.fix: Drop `private` and state it for an arbitrary measurable set: `theorem emissionLaw_apply {s : Set ℝ} (hs : MeasurableSet s) : emissionLaw K T s = ∫⁻ t in s ∩ Iic T, ENNReal.ofReal (K t * sudakov K t T)`, with the `Iic` form as the specialisation used in the file.
findings.issue: `emissionLaw_Iic_eq_lintegral` is `private`, so the only public values of `emissionLaw` are on `Iic` (`emissionLaw_Iic`, under `hK`/`hK0`/`hdiv`). A consumer that needs the mass of an `Ioc` proposal interval or an integral against the one-step law (Layer 2.2's chain of proposals) must `rw [emissionLaw]` and unfold the `withDensity` body.

findings.evidence: EmissionScale.lean:112 `rw [sudakov, Real.one_le_exp_iff, neg_nonneg, ...]`; EmissionScale.lean:143-145 `have hzero : Tendsto ... := by simpa [sudakov, Function.comp_def]`; Sudakov.lean:138 `sudakov_le_one` is the only bound currently exported.
findings.fix: Add to `Sudakov.lean` beside `sudakov_le_one`: `one_le_sudakov (h : ∫ s in t..T, K s ≤ 0) : 1 ≤ sudakov K t T` and `tendsto_sudakov_atBot (hdiv : Tendsto (fun t => ∫ s in t..T, K s) atBot atTop) : Tendsto (fun t => sudakov K t T) atBot (𝓝 0)`, and use them instead of `rw [sudakov]`/`simpa [sudakov]`.
findings.issue: Two reusable facts about `sudakov` are unfolded inline for want of lemmas: `emissionCdf_of_ge` proves `1 ≤ sudakov K x T` by `rw [sudakov, Real.one_le_exp_iff, ...]` — the missing dual of the existing `sudakov_le_one` — and `setIntegral_Iic_sudakov_density` hides `Tendsto (fun t => sudakov K t T) atBot (𝓝 0)` in a local `have` proved by `simpa [sudakov]` (l.143-145). The latter is the Convention-6 statement that the no-emission probability vanishes at `-∞`, needed again by any later layer.

findings.evidence: EmissionScale.lean:234-235 `have hsud : sudakov (fun _ => r) x T = Real.exp (-((T - x) * r)) := by rw [sudakov, intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]`; `grep -n sudakov` shows no evaluation lemma in Sudakov.lean (only `sudakov_self`, `sudakov_pos`, `sudakov_le_one`).
findings.fix: Export `sudakov_const (r t T : ℝ) : sudakov (fun _ => r) t T = Real.exp (-((T - t) * r))` in `Sudakov.lean` and `emissionCdf_const (hx : x ≤ T) : emissionCdf (fun _ => r) T x = Real.exp (-((T - x) * r))` here, and use them in `isQuantileFunction_emissionCdf_const`.
findings.issue: The constant-kernel section claims "every ingredient is in closed form", but no closed form is exported: `sudakov (fun _ => r) x T = Real.exp (-((T - x) * r))` exists only as the local `have hsud` inside `isQuantileFunction_emissionCdf_const`, so `emissionCdf (fun _ => r) T` and the law in `hasLaw_add_log_div` stay opaque to consumers (Layer 6's correspondence and the roadmap's exponential example both want the closed form).

findings.evidence: Repo convention: `EpsilonEridani/QFT/Scattering/DIS/Inclusive/CrossSection.lean:139 @[fun_prop] lemma continuous_Yplus`; Mathlib tags the analogous `unitInterval.measurable_symm` (`Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Constructions/UnitInterval.lean:49`) the same way.
findings.issue: `continuous_sudakov` and `continuous_sudakov_density` (EmissionScale.lean:116) are the lemmas automation should use to discharge continuity/integrability side goals downstream, but carry no `@[fun_prop]`; the PR itself chains them by hand (`hK.mul (continuous_sudakov hK T)`, `hcont.integrableOn_Ioc`, `hcont.intervalIntegrable`).

summary: The quantile-function API is complete and correctly scoped, but `emissionLaw` has no public lemma for its value on any set other than `Iic` (the only such lemma is `private`), and three reusable facts about `sudakov` are obtained by unfolding its body inside proofs instead of being exported. The new continuity lemmas also lack `@[fun_prop]`, which this repo uses for exactly such lemmas.
